overview_description.description: Anthropic develops artificial intelligence tools and research initiatives focused on creating AI systems and models for business and research use. The company produces the Claude family of AI products, including conversational and coding assistants, integrations with productivity applications, and developer APIs that organizations can deploy for automation, information retrieval, and task workflows. It also engages in systematic research and analysis of AI behavior, safety methods, and policy issues to inform product design and external stakeholders. Beyond product development, Anthropic generates documented insights and collaborates with academic, civil society, and industry groups to explore implications of AI on economic and societal systems. These efforts aim to connect foundational research with practical AI applications in enterprise environments.
